answer: An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The tundra schedule is applied in spiral and vault shows each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2010 identities would post 1358 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
